text.en:
On Weapon Kill:
15% Increased damage for 7 seconds.

Matching Grenade and Powered Melee Kills while the buff is active grant 50% increased damage for 10 seconds.
Can only be refreshed by getting another Matching Ability Kill.

enhanced (
#e 15% Damage Buff Duration is increased to 8 seconds if a weapon kill is made while it is active.
)
text.zh-chs:
使用此武器造成最后一击时：
+15% 伤害，持续 7 秒。

此增益生效期间，相同伤害类型的手雷或近战击杀会 +50% 伤害，并延长持续时间 10 秒。
持续时间仅可被另一种技能击杀刷新。

enhanced (
#e 武器击杀后的增益持续时间提升为 8 秒。
)

While the perk's buff isn't active, Weapon Kills grant Golden Tricorn x1 for 7 seconds. Additional Kills #refresh

While your Weapon's element matches that of your Super and Golden Tricorn x1 or x2 is active:
Grenade or Powered Melee Kills grant Golden Tricorn x2 for 10 seconds.

Note: having to match the Super element is a known bug and will be changed soon. The element of the abilities procing the 2nd Stack will need to match the Weapon.

var refresh = refresh the buff duration.
enhanced (
var refresh = refresh the buff duration to #e8 seconds.
#e Golden Tricorn x1's duration is refreshed to 8 seconds.
)
